      <section class="talk-description">
        <p>Keep the conversation going after the workshop! Join fellow attendees, speakers and organisers for drinks and a chat at <strong>The Waterside</strong> after the closing discussion.</p>

        <p>We have the <strong>Level 1 Magic Tables</strong> reserved from <strong>6:00 PM to 8:00 PM</strong> on Tuesday 1 December. Space is limited to around 50 people, and walk-ins to the venue are always welcome.</p>

        <p>
          <strong>The Waterside</strong><br>
          508 Flinders Street (corner of King Street)<br>
          Melbourne VIC 3000
        </p>

        <p>The main entrance is at 508 Flinders Street, and there is an accessible entrance on King Street.</p>
